_comment: Absolute target lines per surface. These are NOT claims of superiority; they are the bar we want akanjs to clear, plus the market frameworks we compare against. Calibrate maxP99Ms / minRps to your benchmark hardware on first run, then freeze. See README.md section 'SLO targets'.
hardwareNote: Targets below assume a single modern dev laptop (Apple Silicon / 8+ perf cores), load generator on a separate machine or core set. Treat cross-runtime numbers (Node frameworks vs Bun) as indicative only.

pure_http_no_db.description: Akan gateway/runtime no-DB fast path (or competitor /ping), no SignalContext, no auth, no DB.

signal_no_db.description: Normal Signal query through SignalContext, guards/arg/serialization, no DB/document hydration.

rest_minimal.description: Legacy minimal REST ping scenario. For akanjs this may be a light document fetch; prefer pure_http_no_db and signal_no_db for overhead isolation.

rest_realistic.description: JWT verify + single DB read + schema serialization. Apples-to-apples with peers configured the same way.

db_find_one.description: Indexed single-document fetch by id through the document store / DataLoader.

db_list.description: Paginated list (limit 20) with sort; should stay at 2 DB queries/request after DataLoader batching.

db_relation.description: List with nested relation resolution (DataLoader batching, N+1 avoidance).

websocket_fanout.description: Local 1 publisher to N subscribers fan-out latency and message throughput.

ssr_rsc.description: Server-rendered page TTFB and render throughput. EXPERIMENTAL react-server-dom-bun; treat vs Next.js as maturity-caveated.

fullstack_e2e.description: login -> list -> create scenario, end-to-end iteration latency.

regression._comment: Allowed drift vs stored baseline before CI fails. Latency may rise by this fraction; throughput may fall by this fraction.
